purpose: Seed journals for building systems, building information, indoor environment, controls, and energy. This is a search starting set, not an exclusion whitelist.

metric_policy.priority: At search time prioritize topic-relevant journals in the current JCR/Scopus top quartile or with strong field standing.
metric_policy.verification: Record metric name, value or quartile, edition year, and official source at runtime.
prohibitions: Do not hard-code a permanent Impact Factor threshold.
Do not exclude a relevant study solely because its journal has a lower metric.
Do not compare raw Impact Factors across unrelated categories as if field-normalized.

seed_journals: Science and Technology for the Built Environment
Building Services Engineering Research and Technology
Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering
Journal of Information Technology in Construction
IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering

discovery_sources: PubMed for indoor environment and health

full_text_access_preferences.credential_policy: Never commit credentials, cookies, session tokens, or licensed PDFs

expansion_rules: Add journals found repeatedly in included-study references or forward citations.
Add domain journals when the RQ introduces health, controls, power systems, semantics, databases, or human factors.
Search special issues and early-access/in-press records.
Record additions, rationale, date, and source in LITERATURE.md.
